publishedRecipe.name: Lemon Chicken & Asparagus Stir Fry with Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash the cauliflower and remove the leaves. Using a food processor or box grater, grate to rice-like texture. Transfer to a large bowl and set aside.
In a skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add the cauliflower and cook, stirring occasionally, until the rice is slightly browned and tender, 7-10 minutes. Return to the bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Grate zest from the lemon.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger
1 lemon

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, create a slurry by whisking together water with cornstarch until smooth. Add the minced garlic and ginger, lemon zest and juice, soy sauce, and honey and whisk together. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp water
2 tsp cornstarch
zest and juice from 1 lemon
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Wash the asparagus and snap (or cut) off the woody ends. Cut on an angle into 2 inch pieces. Transfer to a bowl.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the cauliflower rice has been removed, add more oil to the skillet. Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Once the chicken has been removed, add more oil to the skillet. Add asparagus and cook, stirring occasionally, until bright green and tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and pour in the sauce. Stir-fry until heated through and sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes.
Place cauliflower rice in a bowl and top with the stir fry. Enjoy!
